name: Patchline ethics review template for evidence expansion and live learning

entries.title: Public incident-note corpus expansion
entries.purpose: Expand real data-change hazard evidence while excluding private source code and unlicensed artifacts.
entries.consent_basis: Public-license and public-interest review before a case enters the evidence marketplace or benchmark.
entries.privacy_review: Only already-public remediation facts, evidence hashes, and source-free summaries may be retained.
entries.retention_policy: Raw review notes expire after 90 days; normalized hashes and license metadata remain for reproducibility.
entries.minimization: Store case identifiers, license class, detector class, and evidence hashes instead of raw incident narratives when possible.
entries.withdrawal_path: Submitters and affected maintainers can request quarantine before public release.

entries.title: Adopter-local calibration feedback
entries.purpose: Detect calibration drift from adopter feedback without collecting source code, findings, or reviewer identities.
entries.consent_basis: Adopter opt-in and local export control for aggregate outcome metrics.
entries.privacy_review: Feedback leaves the adopter only as cohort-bucketed counts above the minimum group size.
entries.retention_policy: Operational feedback expires, anonymizes, or aggregates under the live feedback retention lifecycle.
entries.minimization: No source snippets, individual reviewer IDs, or raw finding IDs leave the adopter boundary.
entries.withdrawal_path: Adopters can pause exports and require deletion before aggregate publication.
entries.human_oversight: Release council approval is required before any calibration change can affect blocking policy.

entries.title: Maintainer review-time outcome study
entries.purpose: Measure whether generated remediation plans reduce maintainer review time without hiding uncertainty or increasing over-reliance.
entries.consent_basis: Study participants opt in before paired timing aggregates are collected.
entries.privacy_review: Reports publish aggregate deltas, uncertainty recall, and burden intervals without reviewer identifiers.
entries.retention_policy: Raw timing logs expire after the preregistered analysis window closes.
entries.minimization: Retain only paired deltas, confidence intervals, and hashed study artifacts.
entries.withdrawal_path: Participants can withdraw their run before aggregate lock.
